data.data_quality_notes: The claims development table has an unusual structure where the 'Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred' rows represent the ultimate estimate at different development points, rather than cumulative incurred claims. Prior year development was calculated by comparing the ultimate estimate for the 2021 underwriting year from the 2022 report (210 $'000) to the ultimate estimate for the same year in the 2023 report (14 $'000).
